name: the sound of rain.
source:
Sis always told me that ghosts are not real.
That when we die, we just disappear.
Forever.

[From [url=https://qteatime.itch.io/the-sound-of-rain-remake]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
姐姐总是告诉我鬼魂不是真的。
当我们死后，我们就消失了。
永远。

[来自[url=https://qteatime.itch.io/the-sound-of-rain-remake]Itch.io[/url]]
